city.summary_zh: 世遗古城+稻田+安邦海滩，节奏比岘港更慢，适合住岘港-会安双城。
city.summary_en: Heritage old town, rice fields and An Bang beach; slower than Da Nang, works well as a Da Nang-Hoi An dual base.

neighborhoods.name: 古城 Cam Pho
neighborhoods.vibe: 世遗灯笼老街，白天游客多、夜晚热闹
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 daytripsvietnam 古城区 $400–650 中值

neighborhoods.name: 安邦海滩 An Bang
neighborhoods.vibe: 海滩+外籍社区，咖啡馆酒吧集中
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 daytripsvietnam 安邦 $300–500 中值

neighborhoods.name: 锦州 Cam Chau
neighborhoods.vibe: 稻田环绕，骑车可达古城与海滩
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 expat.com 1居 $250–400 中值

neighborhoods.name: 锦清 Cam Thanh
neighborhoods.vibe: 椰林水乡，家庭友好、极安静
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 daytripsvietnam 郊区 $200–350 中值
